name: Greedy Voxel Mesh Optimization
definition: A greedy algorithm to optimize voxel mesh generation for 2D tile grids (e.g., Minecraft-like games) by merging adjacent identical tiles into larger rectangular quads to reduce draw calls.
summary: Greedy Voxel Mesh Optimization merges adjacent identical tiles into maximal rectangular quads to reduce draw calls, distinguishing itself by explicitly constructing these regions through iterative expansion rather than using bit-packing or parallel scan techniques.
